About Me

Strategy with
real impact.

I'm a Business & Operations Analyst who thrives in the structured chaos of early-stage startups. My work sits at the intersection of data, strategy, and execution — turning messy information into clear decisions.

With experience in Founder's Office environments, I've built SOPs, maintained MIS reporting pipelines, mapped user journeys, and produced investor-ready briefs — all while keeping sprint cycles on track and stakeholders aligned.

I approach every engagement with a compliance-first, entrepreneurial mindset, bringing structured problem-solving to cross-functional teams and translating complex data into narratives that actually move people to act.
